messages:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT: cont-batching path p99 spike in us-west2 (prod). Streaming stalls observed, p95 ~1.2s -> 2.6s, p99 ~1.8s -> 5.8s, SLO=1.5s. Auto-pager: @oncall-raj tagged. Dashboard: https://grafana.example.com/d/contbatch/streaming?s=1718129900
oncall-raj: On it. Observed any customer-facing errors? Any 5xx or only latency?
sre-jen: No spike in 5xx; requests are mostly successful but streaming stalls (clients see long pauses between chunks). Some customers reported degraded UX.
ml-nina: Looks like mixed sequence-length workload. Trace snippets show packer holding tiny-seq requests behind a long-seq request for ~120ms before scheduling. That compounds with KV cache misses and results in tail latency.
infra-lee: Checking node-level metrics — a subset of servers (pool streaming-usw2-a) have elevated GPU utilization ~92% and high paging activity at the runtime layer (page faults up). Could be mem jitter from KV cache churn.
oncall-raj: Immediate mitigation plan: 1) reduce packer max_batch_size for streaming pool, 2) enable aggressive preemptive-shedding for mixedlen, 3) route new streaming sessions to burst pool with reserved capacity, 4) notify SRE and PM for customer impact. Assigning tasks.
ml-nina: I can flip packer config quickly. Suggested values: packer.max_batch_size: 32 -> 12, packer.max_wait_ms: 50 -> 15, preempt.shed_threshold: 0.9 -> 0.7. Will patch config and reload.
eng-tasha: If we shrink batch_size we may increase cost slightly but it should reduce tail. Good trade for live mitigation.
infra-lee: I'll open routing rule to divert new streaming traffic to streaming-burst-usw2 (2 nodes) while we remediate. Doing a graceful 60s drain on the problematic pool.
pm-alex: Notifying affected customers via incident page. No escalation to execs yet but will update if p99 stays >2s after mitigation.
deploy-bot: Deploy started by ml-nina: packer-config/2026-03-15T14:07Z (ID: d8f3c) 
ml-nina: Patch applied to packer config on streaming-usw2-a/b. Reduced max_batch_size and max_wait_ms. Preemptive-shedding toggled to 0.7.
sre-jen: Observing metrics post-patch: p95 back to ~1.1s within 45s, p99 trending down from 5.8s to 2.0s. Still seeing occasional 3-4s tails on older sessions.
oncall-raj: Next: infra-lee please complete routing change. eng-tasha please prepare to enable per-request KV-prefetch for short sessions to reduce cache misses. ml-nina keep monitoring packer queue lengths.
infra-lee: Routing update: traffic diverted to streaming-burst-usw2, new sessions show ~20% lower latency. Draining old pool done.
eng-tasha: KV-prefetch flag staged as feature-flag; enabling on streaming-burst for low-risk rollout. Command: 
```
redwoodctl flags set --env prod --pool streaming-burst-usw2 --flag kv_prefetch=true
```
eng-tasha: Flag enabled on burst pool. Observing fewer KV misses, tail counts decreasing.
ml-nina: Metric snapshot 2min post-routing: p99 now ~1.4s, p95 ~0.9s. Still tracking a handful of long-lived streams that hit older nodes and show sequence amplification.
sre-jen: For the long-lived streams we can try an internal nudge to re-establish connection (client reconnect) or proactively migrate state to new pool; but migration is risky mid-stream. Suggest we mark those sessions as "best-effort" and prioritize new connections to the burst pool.
oncall-raj: Agreed. Customer comms: PM Alex post interim status: degraded UX for some customers, mitigation in place, p99 improved but monitoring continues.
pm-alex: Posted update to incident page and messaged top 3 affected customers via DM.
ml-nina: Postmortem-actions (recording here): 1) Add packer adaptive limit based on observed seqlen variance 2) Make preemptive-shedding the default for streaming when heterogeneity > threshold 3) Add runtime KV eviction smoothing to avoid mem jitter 4) Build expedited route for short-session streaming to reserved burst capacity 5) Create an eval that simulates mixed-seqlen walking-load for CI.
oncall-raj: Any remaining immediate action items?
infra-lee: I'll keep the burst pool warm for 2 hours and monitor paging.
sre-jen: I'll follow up with automated alert tuning to catch this pattern earlier (packers queue skew / KV churn).
eng-tasha: I'll prototype a lightweight session migration tool for long-lived streams (low priority).
pm-alex: I'll draft customer-facing RCA outline after we stabilize.
oncall-raj: Closing on-call handoff: I'll keep this incident open but moving to "live-mitigation". If p99 stays <1.6s for next 30m we can close. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Incident status changed: mitigation in progress -> monitoring. Page suppressed for oncall-rotation until resolved.
